tasks.title: Conversation #104
tasks.transcript:
Man: Did you manage to get the tickets for the soccer match tonight?
Woman: Yes, I bought them online earlier this morning. We got lucky. There were only a few seats left.
Man: That's great. What time does the match kick off?
Woman: It starts at 7 p.m. If we leave by 6, we should have enough time to find a parking place and get to our seats before kickoff.
Man: Right. We need to leave early.

questions.stem: What did the woman do this morning?

options.A: She picked up some tickets at a stadium.
options.B: She bought tickets online for a soccer match.
options.D: She called to check a match schedule.

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：女士今天早上做了什么？ 定位原文：Woman: Yes, I bought them online earlier this morning. 选项分析： A. She picked up some tickets at a stadium. 她在体育场取了票。女士明确说是网上购票，并未提及去体育场取票，所以A选项错误。 B. She bought tickets online for a soccer match. 她在网上买了足球赛的票。女士说“bought them online”，其中“them”指代上文男士问的“tickets for the soccer match”，所以B选项正确。 C. She reserved a parking spot. 她预留了一个停车位。对话中未提及预留停车位，所以C选项错误。 D. She called to check a match schedule. 她打电话核对比赛时间表。对话中未提及打电话，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: Why do the speakers want to leave early?

options.D: To pick up some friends on the way

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：说话者为什么想早点出发？ 定位原文：Woman: If we leave by 6, we should have enough time to find a parking place and get to our seats before kickoff. 选项分析： A. To find a parking spot 为了找停车位。女士明确说需要时间“find a parking place”（找到停车位），所以A选项正确。 B. To avoid traffic 为了避开交通拥堵。对话中未提及交通拥堵情况，所以B选项错误。 C. To eat before an event 在活动前吃饭。对话中未提及吃饭，所以C选项错误。 D. To pick up some friends on the way 在路上接朋友。对话中未提及接朋友，所以D选项错误。
